typed_route_proof_expectations.business_meaning: DELL AI-server revenue must enter the candidate pool from request metric and product intent, not from a qrel or answer URL.
The exact operating-cash-flow row must outrank lease payments, free-cash-flow and financing rows when proxies are forbidden.
Manufacturing supply and capacity must be distinguishable from commercial-paper or market-capacity homonyms.

bge_reranker.node_purpose: Re-score the bounded candidate union after typed metric and product alias routes change which objects are naturally recalled.
bge_reranker.input_scale: Eighteen atoms, no more than ten needs per atom and ninety-six candidates per atom; every candidate is scored against every bounded need.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
bge_reranker.schema_burden: flat pair scores plus deterministic all-need aggregation and typed-route receipts
bge_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: without exact operating-cash-flow and product-domain aliases, a semantic reranker receives the wrong candidate set and cannot recover missing evidence
bge_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: the frozen v1.3 union missed DELL AI-server reported results, ranked NVDA operating cash flow at 38 and placed capacity homonyms in the head
bge_reranker.reasoning_profile: local cross-encoder scoring; no generation, network access or training
bge_reranker.stop_and_truncation: maximum 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, bounded need/candidate matrix, fail on score-count or identity drift

qwen_reranker.node_purpose: Independently test whether typed candidate recall improves Qwen head ordering without making the reranker a financial authority.
qwen_reranker.input_scale: Same bounded candidate-need matrix as BGE over eighteen development atoms.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
qwen_reranker.schema_burden: instruction-aware local scoring followed by deterministic aggregation
qwen_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: generic relevance can still prefer a semantically related wrong metric; final intent and Evidence gates remain independent
qwen_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: v1.3 all-need reranking did not improve head quality because the earliest failure was typed intent recall and discrimination
qwen_reranker.reasoning_profile: local reranker shadow; no generation, network access or training
qwen_reranker.stop_and_truncation: maximum 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, bounded need/candidate matrix, fail on score-count or identity drift

why_new_attempt_is_justified: the label-only replay improved observed useful@10 from 6/15 to 13/15 but exposed 38 confirmed hard negatives in the first ten
DELL reported AI-server results were absent from the frozen union, so no reranker or Evidence evaluator could recover them
NVDA operating cash flow was present only at rank 38 because operating-lease and free-cash-flow rows shared generic cash terminology
capacity terms crossed manufacturing supply, cloud leases, commercial paper and market-risk domains
all three failures share one provider-neutral typed-intent boundary rather than three case-specific phrase patches
not_changed: local embedding and reranker model identities
